After initial construction and if safety, engineering, service, or reliability constraints dictate, the Grantee
shall have the right, from time to time, to relocate all or any portion of the above described electric system

discretion shall deem appropriate. The expense of such relocation and installation shall be the expense of

structures so as to cause the least possible interference with lawful use of the property, so long as such
locations do not materially increase the cost of construction, operation, repair, maintenance, relocation or
replacement of the electric system or any portion thereof.

The Grantor(s) covenant and agree that no structure, building, or fixture shall be placed over underground
conduits, wires or lines and no structure, building, or fixture shall be constructed, erected, or maintained
within the above-described real estate.

livestock, or other use, so long as any such use shall not in the reasonable opinion of the Grantee
